items.t: Spark plug blows out of the cylinder head
items.job: Repair spark plug threads with an insert, new plug and coil
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $200-$500. Plugs on van engines are harder to reach than on pickups, so labor runs high.

items.t: Cracked plastic intake manifold leaks coolant
items.job: Replace intake manifold and gaskets

items.t: Head gasket failure (6.0L diesel)
items.job: Replace head gaskets and install head studs
items.note: On the E-Series the cab usually has to come apart or the engine has to come out, which pushes labor up. Cracked heads or block cost far more.

items.t: Oil cooler clogs and EGR cooler cracks (6.0L diesel)
items.job: Replace engine oil cooler and EGR cooler

items.t: Injector control module (FICM) failure (6.0L diesel)
items.job: Replace fuel injection control module (FICM)

items.t: Sticking turbo vanes and injectors (6.0L diesel)
items.job: Remove and clean turbo vanes, replace unison ring
items.note: Replacing sticking injectors costs much more.

items.t: 6.0L diesel may stall without warning (recall)
items.job: Upgrade injector module harness or sensor connector

items.t: Camshaft position sensor failure (7.3L diesel)
items.job: Replace camshaft position sensor

items.t: Misfires from injector wiring or driver module (7.3L diesel)
items.job: Replace under-valve-cover injector harness
items.note: A replacement injector driver module costs more, roughly several hundred dollars.

items.t: Coolant contamination from injector sleeves or oil cooler (7.3L diesel)
items.job: Reseal oil cooler or replace injector sleeves
items.note: Oil cooler seals are the lower end; injector sleeves need the injectors out and take much longer.

items.t: Cruise control switch can overheat and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Install fused wiring harness for cruise control switch

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report an average of about $4,600.

items.t: Check engine light with transmission solenoid codes
items.job: Diagnose and replace transmission solenoid body

items.t: Fuel tank lining breaks down and clogs the fuel system
items.job: Replace fuel tank, filters and clean fuel system

items.t: Fuel rail crossover hose can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel rail assembly

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.job: Inspect and grease wiper motor gear

items.t: Rear axle failure
items.job: Rebuild rear differential (gears and bearings)

items.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling, then replace failed sensor or fuel part
items.note: Cost depends entirely on the cause found.

items.t: Driver seat track can break in a crash (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace driver seat track

items.t: Windshield may form bubbles in heat (recall)
items.job: Replace windshield

items.t: Seat bolts may break (recall)
items.job: Replace seat mounting bolts

items.t: A/C cools poorly
items.job: Diagnose A/C, recharge or replace compressor control valve
items.note: A full compressor replacement is the high end.

items.t: Trailer brake controller may not apply trailer brakes (recall)
items.job: Reprogram powertrain control module

items.t: Backup camera image may fail (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair or replace rearview camera

items.t: Engine cover can get too hot (recall)
items.job: Reposition engine cover insulation and update software

items.t: Power steering line can leak and cut brake assist (recall)
items.job: Repair power steering line connection at hydroboost

items.t: Wiring can rub through and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Repair and reroute rear wiring harness

items.t: Rear axle may be low on fluid (recall)
items.job: Check and top up rear axle fluid

items.t: Fuel tank seam can rust and leak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace fuel tank if needed

items.t: Rear brake rotor bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and torque rear rotor bolts

items.t: Park may not hold the vehicle (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace transmission parts

items.t: Blower motor may fail and disable the defroster (recall)
items.job: Replace HVAC blower motor

items.t: Backup alarm may not sound (recall)
items.job: Secure or replace backup alarm connector

items.t: Rough running and misfires with check engine light
items.job: Replace ignition coil and spark plug on the misfiring cylinder
items.note: Replacing all plugs on a van engine takes several hours because of limited access.

items.t: Front end rattles and loose steering
items.job: Replace worn ball joints or tie rod ends, then align
